component.name: Bearings
component.summary: Find your footing on Bazzite Linux

description.p: Bearings is a free, local companion for anyone new to Bazzite — the gaming-focused, immutable, Fedora-based Linux distro. It's the field guide you wish you'd had switching over: the things nobody tells you, and a lookup table matching the apps you already use to their Linux equivalents.
It's meant to be something you come back to as you learn, not open once and delete.

ul.li: Familiar Territory — a table matching your Windows, Mac, or ChromeOS apps to what to use on Bazzite, with honest notes on the trade-offs
A deck of bite-sized tips across everyday use, gaming, creating, coding, and self-hosting — swipe through them or check them off as they click
Printable cheat sheets for the most useful ujust commands and KDE keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Everything runs on your machine. No account, no login, no telemetry, no analytics — nothing phones home. The only time it touches the internet is an optional check for updated tips (off by default) and when you tap an external link.

The Deck — one tip at a time, focused on your topics
